name: Brady Bloxham
biography: is founder and Principal Security Consultant at Silent Break Security, where he focuses on providing advanced, custom penetration testing services. Brady started his career working for the various three letter agencies, where he earned multiple awards for exceptional performance in conducting classified network operations. Brady stays current in the information security field by presenting at various hacker conferences, as well as providing training on building custom offensive security tools and advanced penetration testing techniques. Brady also maintains the PwnOS project and holds several highly respected industry certifications. :)
